baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic predication joins قَوْلٌ to فَصْلٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: An utterance is identified with the act of adjudicative separation: speaking does not merely describe a distinction but performs a ruling that partitions truth from falsehood.

activation_trace.role: The uttered-speech branch supplies the voiced act that carries out, rather than merely reports, the discrimination.
The judgment branch supplies a ruling that separates truth from falsehood and gives the utterance performative force.

changed_reading.before: It is a statement that happens to be decisive.
changed_reading.after: It is speech whose saying itself executes a decisive judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْلٌ can be indication or definition, while فَصْلٌ can be clarification by articulated parts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can name a mode of disclosure broader than vocal speech: a thing signifies, its essence is stated, and differentiation makes its component meanings legible.

activation_trace.role: The indication branch lets a thing's signifying count as its saying, widening qawl beyond audible words.
The definition branch supplies an account that states what a thing is and makes the utterance explanatory.
The detailing branch turns separation into clarification by laying out distinct parts and meanings.

changed_reading.before: The line commends the firmness of a spoken assertion.
changed_reading.after: The line names a disclosure that defines by separating and displaying constituent meanings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speech root and the separating adjective share branches of tongue, joint, and formal textual division.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech becomes articulated when a continuous stream is given joints and boundaries. The short clause can therefore describe both intelligible utterance and the formal divider that organizes adjacent units.

activation_trace.role: The tongue-as-instrument branch supplies the organ that converts an undivided stream into articulated speech.
The articulating-tongue branch makes distinction within expression the mechanism of intelligibility.
The joint branch supplies a boundary that also connects parts, preventing separation from meaning mere disintegration.
The formal-separator branch locates the same operation in verse endings and divisions of discourse.

changed_reading.before: Fasl qualifies only the content of qawl.
changed_reading.after: Fasl also names the joints and boundaries by which qawl becomes articulate and structurally ordered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْلٌ has an authority-bearing title branch, and فَصْلٌ has both judgment and issuing-out branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying can be heard as an authoritative determination put into motion: a word has force because it leaves its source as a dispatch whose ruling is no longer merely deliberative.

activation_trace.role: The titled-chief branch supplies a speaker whose word carries public force, activating institutional authority.
The judgment branch supplies the settled determination carried by the authoritative word.
The issuing-out branch supplies movement from source toward recipient, making the ruling a dispatched act.

changed_reading.before: The saying expresses a settled opinion.
changed_reading.after: The saying is an authoritative determination issued toward execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies a marked, arriving, visible phenomenon that strikes and penetrates. Anchored to qawl-as-indication and fasl-as-opening, the focus saying becomes an event that communicates by breaching the barrier between hidden and manifest.

activation_trace.role: The indication branch makes the focus qawl capable of being a sign-event rather than voice alone.
The basic-separation branch supplies the opening produced when the signal passes from concealment into visibility.
The non-dominant split contributes a visible identifying mark, turning the sky cue into a legible sign surface.
The measured-strike branch gives the nocturnal arrival an impact that initiates disclosure.
The emerging-visible branch supplies the transition from hiddenness to perceptible appearance.
The penetration-through-an-aperture branch supplies the barrier-crossing action assigned to the separating saying.

structural_cues: 86:1-3 delays the identity of the arriving sign and then resolves it as something visibly penetrating.
The focus clause later repeats the same movement from an unresolved pronoun to a sharply classified qawl.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mark, arrival, impact, appearance, penetration, indication, and separation; I infer that the qawl communicates by making a breach through which the hidden becomes manifest. A live alternative is that the star sequence only warrants the saying's truth without modeling its operation.

changed_reading.before: The qawl states a distinction already available to hearers.
changed_reading.after: The qawl is a penetrating sign whose arrival creates access to the distinction it announces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to direct perception toward origin, together with creation as measure and capacity as attained power, revises the disclosive baseline into an evidential procedure: inspect, discriminate measured features, then formulate the defining account.

activation_trace.role: The definition branch supplies the explanatory account reached after inspection.
The detailing branch supplies analytical separation of the observed process into intelligible parts.
The directed-sight-or-insight branch supplies the act of inquiry rather than passive reception.
The measuring-and-proportioning branch makes created origin available as structured evidence.
The bounded-measure branch supplies a limit against which the observed account can become discriminating.

structural_cues: 86:5 poses origin as a question and commands looking before 86:6-7 supplies material details.
86:8 converts the observed origin sequence into a claim about capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed inspection, measured creation, bounded measure, definition, and detailing; I infer an abductive path from material traces to the focus account. A live alternative is that the inspection only supports a prior assertion and that qawl remains wholly declarative.

changed_reading.before: The defining qawl descends as an assertion independent of inquiry.
changed_reading.after: The defining qawl is also the discriminating account elicited by looking closely at measured origin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self's inward content is retained, then subjected to a test that reveals condition. This activates qawl as unspoken inner saying and fasl as the adjudication that converts concealed commitment into differentiating evidence.

activation_trace.role: The inner-saying branch locates qawl in thought before public articulation.
The judgment branch turns recovered inward content into evidence that separates true commitment from presentation.
The inward-intellect branch supplies content held within the self as the object of later disclosure.
The retention-in-the-self branch supplies persistence, allowing hidden content to remain available for examination.
The testing-and-manifestation branch supplies the operation by which an inward condition becomes evident.
The hiding-in-the-interior branch supplies the concealment that the test overcomes.

structural_cues: 86:4 places a keeper over every self, while 86:9 names a day when inward matters undergo exposure.
The focus qawl follows the loss of personal force and external help in 86:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward content, retention, concealment, testing, manifestation, inner qawl, and judgment; I infer a record-to-evidence arrow in which what was preserved inwardly returns as discriminating testimony. A live alternative is that preservation is protective and the tested secrets are acts rather than inner speech.

changed_reading.before: The decisive qawl is only an external proclamation addressed to the self.
changed_reading.after: The decisive qawl can also be the self's preserved inward saying made manifest and adjudicative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence pictures fluid driven outward through a between-space bounded by firm bodily structures. The tongue and joint branches in the focus transfer that material geometry to speech: articulation is generated by pressure, passage, and a boundary between parts.

activation_trace.role: The tongue branch gives qawl an embodied production site rather than treating it as disembodied content.
The articulating-tongue branch supplies the speech operation generated at the bodily boundary.
The joint branch supplies a meeting-place between rigid parts through which differentiated motion becomes possible.
The reproductive-fluid branch supplies the generative material whose passage begins the analogy.
The single-surge branch supplies pressure and directional movement through the constrained passage.
The outward-penetration branch supplies emergence as the result of the passage.
The middle-between-two branch supplies the relational space in which generation and articulation occur.
The back-and-vertebrae branch supplies one firm bodily boundary around the emerging flow.
The chest branch supplies the opposing bodily region that completes the between-space.

structural_cues: 86:6-7 gives a material sequence of fluid, surge, outward motion, and emergence from between named bodily structures.
The focus phrase couples speech to a root whose inventory includes both articulating tongue and bodily joint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generative fluid, surge, emergence, a bounded middle, tongue, and joint; I supply the cross-domain arrow that speech, like the created body, becomes articulate through constrained emergence. A live alternative is that the material sequence supports only return-capacity and contributes no model of speech production.

changed_reading.before: Qawl fasl is an abstract criterion applied after speech is produced.
changed_reading.after: Qawl fasl also images speech being generated at a bodily joint, where pressure through a between-space produces articulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Returning water meets receptive earth and a crack becomes the route of emergence. The focus separation is therefore not only exclusion or verdict; it can be a productive opening through which a recurrent sign produces visible life.

activation_trace.role: The indication branch lets the material cycle function as a saying embodied in observable process.
The terrain-gap and water-channel branch turns separation into a passage that enables flow.
The over-arching sky branch supplies the upper source region of the recurrent material cycle.
The returning-rain branch supplies recurrence as repeated input rather than a one-time strike.
The soft, growth-bearing earth branch supplies a receptive medium rather than a merely inert lower surface.
The plant-splitting-earth branch supplies emergence as the productive result of rupture.

structural_cues: 86:11 and 86:12 form a paired upper/lower sequence immediately before the focus claim.
Return precedes rupture, so the packet permits a recurrence-to-emergence mechanism without making it mandatory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sky, returning rain, receptive earth, plant rupture, indication, and a water-bearing gap; I infer that recurrence enters the opening and makes separation generative. A live alternative is that the paired images only attest power and that fasl remains strictly judicial.

changed_reading.before: Fasl cuts alternatives apart and closes a case.
changed_reading.after: Fasl can also open a channel through which recurrence makes a latent distinction emerge into form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Focus branches allow qawl as negotiation and fasl as settlement with a partner. The explicit absence of gathered strength and assisting support removes the leverage that sustains bargaining, revising the phrase into a settlement no counterparty can reopen by force or coalition.

activation_trace.role: The mutual-negotiation branch supplies the deliberative relation that the context's negations shut down.
The partner-settlement branch supplies division or settlement of a shared matter as the legal-social mechanism.
The judgment branch supplies the unilateral determination that remains after negotiation loses leverage.
The gathered-strength branch supplies coercive capacity, whose explicit negation removes one route of resistance.
The aid-and-vindication branch supplies coalition support, whose explicit negation removes the other route of resistance.

structural_cues: 86:10 explicitly negates both personal force and an assisting party immediately before the oath pair and focus claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negotiation, partner settlement, judgment, and grammatically negated force and aid; I infer that loss of leverage converts a negotiable relation into non-reopenable adjudication. A live alternative is that the negations describe only bodily helplessness and do not qualify the speech act.

changed_reading.before: The qawl is one strong position within a possible dispute.
changed_reading.after: The qawl is a settlement beyond renegotiation because neither force nor ally can reopen it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus clause stands between a paired sky/earth return-and-crack image and the immediate exclusion of unserious speech. Its own formal-separator and joint branches make the line perform what it says: it marks a boundary while joining material sign to social consequence.

activation_trace.role: The uttered-speech branch supplies the discourse unit whose placement can have formal force.
The verse-and-text separator branch directly supplies the possibility that the focus line is a formal division.
The joint branch prevents the formal boundary from being merely a break: it also articulates the adjacent movements.
The sky branch supplies the upper member of the paired material section immediately before the hinge.
The returning-water branch gives the first member a recurrent motion that the next member answers.
The lower-earth branch supplies the complementary member opposite the sky.
The crack-in-a-solid branch closes the material pair on an image of division just before fasl names division.
The speech-without-seriousness branch supplies the immediately excluded discourse mode on the far side of the hinge.

structural_cues: 86:11-12 is a balanced oath pair; 86:13 is the compact focus predication; 86:14 is a compact negated contrast.
The semantic claim of separation coincides with a visible change from material signs to speech, plotting, and delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a formal-separator branch, a joint branch, balanced preceding images, and an immediate opposed speech mode; I infer that the line's position enacts its own separating claim. A live alternative is that the placement is only a conventional bridge and carries no self-referential force.

changed_reading.before: The line describes the qawl as separating.
changed_reading.after: The line itself acts as a separating joint, articulating two movements of the discourse while excluding jest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored repetition of plotting by opposed agents activates the authoritative-dispatch baseline. The focus saying can function as a strategic countermeasure: its issued judgment cuts the adversarial plan away from the effect it seeks.

activation_trace.role: The authority-bearing-word branch supplies public force to the response within the strategic contest.
The issuing-out branch supplies dispatch from one agent toward another rather than static description.
The judgment branch supplies the separating result imposed by the countermeasure.
The deception-and-contrivance branch supplies the first agent's covert attempt to control an outcome.
The repeated branch under the opposing subject supplies a matched counter-operation rather than an unrelated threat.

structural_cues: 86:15 and 86:16 mirror the same verb-noun root pattern while reversing the acting subject.
The plotting exchange follows directly after the focus claim and its exclusion of jest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an authoritative word, an issuing judgment, and mirrored opposed contrivance; I infer that the qawl is itself or commissions the operation that severs scheme from intended result. A live alternative is that the qawl merely announces a counter-plan carried out by other means.

changed_reading.before: The qawl pronounces a verdict after the strategic contest is settled.
changed_reading.after: The qawl enters the contest as an issued countermeasure that decisively disables the rival scheme.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final repeated commands of forbearance separate determination from execution. An authoritative, issued judgment can be completely settled while its implementation remains deliberately paced, so fasl marks finality of status rather than instantaneity of effect.

activation_trace.role: The authority-bearing-word branch supplies a determination whose force does not depend on immediate execution.
The judgment branch supplies settled legal finality at the level of determination.
The issuing-out branch supplies an executable dispatch whose transit can have a timetable.
The patience-and-non-haste branch supplies deliberate postponement, reinforced by the root's repeated surface occurrence.
The gentleness-and-delay branch specifies the paced manner of implementation rather than weakening the judgment.

structural_cues: 86:17 repeats the delay command in two forms and closes with a word denoting a little, measured respite.
The delay comes after both sides' plotting, so it reads as controlled timing rather than indecision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authoritative judgment, issuing movement, repeated non-haste, and gentle delay; I infer a temporal partition between a final determination and its pending execution. A live alternative is that delay governs only the addressee's conduct and says nothing about the temporal profile of qawl fasl.

changed_reading.before: A decisive word must take effect immediately.
changed_reading.after: The word is final in determination while its execution can remain intentionally delayed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus qawl rather than its surface-dominant speech root. It remains anchored by two explicitly supplied mapped branches and by the focus clause's compact form; downstream prose should label it an acoustic/mapping activation, not a lexical replacement for qawl.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The single noun قَوْلٌ is paired with a formal separator in an exceptionally compressed clause.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant fewness branch supplies compression: very little verbal material can still carry the line's distinction.
The non-dominant carrying-and-lifting branch supplies load-bearing force to that compressed verbal unit.
The formal-separator branch supplies the compact unit's disproportionate structural work within discourse.

changed_reading.before: Decisive force requires an expansive or heavily elaborated statement.
changed_reading.after: A very small verbal unit can lift and bear the structural weight of decisive separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain reading because it activates the explicit weaning branch of fasl through the surrounding creation material. It remains valid as a social-causal model anchored directly in focus qawl and focus fasl; downstream prose should present it as an analogy of status-changing separation, never as the ordinary gloss of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَصْلٌ directly carries a branch of offspring separated from mother or nursing, and قَوْلٌ can supply the declaration that marks the changed status.

activation_trace.role: The uttered-speech branch supplies a public declaration capable of marking a transition in status.
The weaning branch supplies separation from an originating source as maturation rather than punishment.
The bringing-creation-into-being branch supplies the prior dependent origin from which later separation can occur.
The reproductive-fluid branch makes generation and dependence materially present in the context.
The plant-breaking-through-earth branch supplies a second image in which separation produces independent emergence.

changed_reading.before: The decisive qawl separates by condemning or excluding.
changed_reading.after: The decisive qawl can mark a generative severance that ends dependence and establishes a newly independent status.

strongest_changes: The focus line can perform adjudication rather than merely describe a decisive proposition.
Piercing, material emergence, returning rain, and cracked earth turn separation into a mechanism of access and productive disclosure.
Preservation, testing, and hidden inward content allow qawl to return as evidence from within the self.
The line's position activates fasl as a self-enacting textual joint, while the final delay sequence separates settled judgment from execution time.
Mirrored plotting activates the authoritative saying as a strategic countermeasure, not only a retrospective verdict.
summary.what_was_special: The packet sustained several mechanisms that a conservative gloss would collapse: speech as verdict, definition, bodily articulation, formal hinge, penetrating sign, productive opening, negotiated settlement, strategic dispatch, and delayed execution. The supplied split mapping and distant weaning branch also supported contained but live outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The unresolved antecedent of the focus pronoun limits how specifically any model can identify the qawl.
The arrows from material creation or rain-and-rupture to speech mechanics are abductive analogies, not grammatically compelled equations.
The non-dominant split mapping for qawl is packet-valid but remains form-distant and should not displace the dominant speech reading.
The self-enacting hinge may be a real compositional effect or a retrospective activation produced by the formal-separator branch.
